text: Hack Club is a nonprofit community where teenagers learn technology by building software, hardware, and other projects.
Hack Club provides coding clubs, events, workshops, and programs where students can build projects and learn from other students.
Hack Club's main community is focused on teenagers aged 13 to 18. Individual programs may have their own eligibility requirements.
Students can start Hack Club coding clubs where members meet, build projects, learn together, and share their work.
Hack Club is free for teenagers. Its community includes coding clubs, events, workshops, and project-based programs.
GitHub is a web-based platform for hosting Git repositories and collaborating on software projects.
Git is a distributed version control system used to track changes in files and software projects.
A Git repository contains project files together with their version history. A repository can contain multiple branches.
A Git commit records a set of changes made to a project and becomes part of the project's history.
A Git branch is a separate line of development that allows developers to work on changes without directly modifying another branch.
A pull request is used to propose changes to a repository so that the changes can be reviewed before they are merged.
Git is the version control system, while GitHub is a platform that hosts Git repositories and provides collaboration tools.
Open-source software is software whose source code is made available under terms that allow people to use, inspect, modify, or distribute it according to its license.
Python is a high-level programming language known for its readable syntax. It is used for automation, web development, data processing, and many other applications.
A Python function is a reusable block of code that can accept inputs and return a result.
A Python list is an ordered and mutable collection that can contain multiple values.
A Python dictionary stores data as key-value pairs and allows values to be accessed using their keys.
Java is a general-purpose programming language commonly used for object-oriented software development. Java programs run on the Java Virtual Machine.
Object-oriented programming organizes software around objects that contain data and behavior. Common concepts include classes, objects, inheritance, encapsulation, abstraction, and polymorphism.
JavaScript is a programming language widely used to add interactive behavior to websites. It can run in browsers and on servers.
JavaScript can respond to user actions, modify web pages, communicate with servers, and control application behavior in a browser.
Frontend development focuses on the part of a web application that users see and interact with, including layouts, buttons, forms, and navigation.
Backend development handles server-side logic, data processing, database access, authentication, and responses to client requests.
HTML is a markup language used to define the structure and content of web pages.
CSS is used to control the presentation and visual appearance of web pages, including layout, spacing, and typography.
HTTP is a protocol used for communication between clients and servers on the web.
HTTPS is HTTP protected using TLS encryption, which helps protect information exchanged between a client and server.
An API, or Application Programming Interface, defines how software components communicate with each other.
A REST API is an HTTP-based interface commonly organized around resources and HTTP methods such as GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE.
JSON, or JavaScript Object Notation, is a text format commonly used to represent structured data and exchange information between applications.
A database is a system used to store, organize, manage, and retrieve data for applications.
SQL, or Structured Query Language, is commonly used to query and modify data in relational databases.
A relational database organizes data into tables containing rows and columns. Relationships between tables can be represented using keys.
Docker is a platform for developing and running applications using containers. Containers package applications together with their dependencies.
A container is an isolated environment containing an application and the files, libraries, and configuration it needs to run.
FastAPI is a Python web framework used to build APIs. It supports Python type hints, request validation, and automatic API documentation.
FastAPI can generate interactive API documentation automatically from application routes and Python type declarations.
React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces using reusable components.
A React component is a reusable part of a user interface. Components can receive data through props and manage state.
An IP address identifies a network interface on an IP network. IPv4 and IPv6 are two versions of the Internet Protocol.
DNS, or Domain Name System, translates domain names into information such as IP addresses so clients can locate network services.
A client requests a service or resource, while a server provides that service or resource. A web browser commonly acts as a client.
A CPU, or Central Processing Unit, executes instructions and performs general-purpose computations for a computer.
RAM, or Random Access Memory, is temporary working memory used to hold data and instructions that a computer is actively using.
A GPU, or Graphics Processing Unit, performs many operations in parallel and is commonly used for graphics and computational workloads.
Encryption transforms readable data into an encoded form so unauthorized people cannot easily understand it.
Authentication is the process of verifying the identity of a user, device, or system.
